scenarios.title: Structured skill card
scenarios.system:
You have access to a skill called Incident Triage.
Goal: diagnose a production incident.
Inputs: incident summary, available logs, current user impact.
Required output: Root Cause, Evidence, Immediate Action, Verification.
Working rules: do not claim completion without verification; if evidence is missing, say what is missing.
